review:
The Godfather: 3 Pillars of Power is an officially licensed 20-line slot with three bonus modes, Hold and Win mechanics and a progressive jackpot system. Godfather-logo wilds appear on every reel.

Mystery symbols can reveal three bonus tokens. Bronze tokens may trigger Loyalty Bonus Spins, silver tokens Honor Hold & Win Spins, and gold tokens Vengeance Jackpot Spins. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 96.57% RTP. Bonuses arrive about once every 105 spins on average. The three-pillar structure is a neat fit for the source material.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 105 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
